title: "Software"
description: "ThSQCA: an R package for threshold-sweep QCA."
---

**ThSQCA** is an R package that reruns a QCA analysis across a range of thresholds, under identical settings, and records how the sufficiency solutions change. Truth table construction and minimization are delegated to the [QCA](https://cran.r-project.org/package=QCA) package, so the computational core is the same as in a standard analysis.

```r
install.packages("ThSQCA")
library(ThSQCA)
```
